title: Privilege escalation due to use-after-free in the WebRTC: Networking component. (CVE-2026-124919)
description: CVE-2026-124919 is a high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in the WebRTC networking component of Firefox. It allows for privilege escalation and was fixed in Firefox 160 and Firefox ESR 153.7. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 8.8, indicating critical impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability if exploited.
